**Simple:** An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or fixes things like machines, roads, bridges, or computers.

**Example:** The engineer designed a safe and modern bridge for the city.

**Trick:** Think of the words **engine** and **near**. An **engineer** always wants an **engine near** them so they can build, fix, or improve it!

**Simple:** Total, complete, and 100% certain, with no doubts or exceptions.

**Example:** I have absolute trust that my best friend will keep my secret.

**Trick:** Think of the word **absolute** as "**Ab-salute**." Picture a soldier giving a big **salute** to show **absolute** (complete and total) respect.

**Synonym:** unlimited, independent, autocratic, unrestricted, unconditional, categorical, despotic

**Antonym:** relative, limited, dependent, conditional

**Simple:** To have a very strong feeling of liking or caring about someone or something.

**Example:** I love my family and my dog.

**Trick:** The letter **V** in the middle of the word lo**v**e looks like the bottom point of a heart (❤️). Whenever you see lo**v**e, think of a heart!

**Synonym:** aphrodisia, love bird, baby, pet, mate, sleep with, romance, sweetheart, sex, the beast with two backs, coitus, honey, carnality, enjoy, adore, darling, lover, go to bed with, sweetie, cherish

**Antonym:** spite, angst, despise, malice, hate, hatred, indifference

**Simple:** Something that involves or relates to two or more different countries.

**Example:** The airport has many international flights to different countries.

**Trick:** Split the word into **Inter** (which sounds like **enter**) and **national** (countries). Picture yourself **entering** a new **nation** on an **international** trip!
